title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode4 A Rumor

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
Mr. Hiiragi pushed for this to happen...?)

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: But I understand completely why you decided to go with ReLight, Mr. Nakano!

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: On top of being the talk of the town, they've got the backing of a huge agency.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: So, given the choice between MORE MORE JUMP! and ReLight... It's really a no-brainer, right?

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: I still do believe that MORE MORE JUMP! is a great group with a lot of growth potential...

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: However, if we're thinking about long-term stability, then ReLight is the correct way to go.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line:
Exactly. But still...
When's the last time Mr. Hiiragi personally came over to pitch his group?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, there's nothing strange about a producer coming over to pitch his or her own group...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If anything, it's perfectly normal to do so since you want them to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It doesn't matter if MORE MORE JUMP! is competing for the same spot. I know that.)

rows.Speaker: Magazine Editor
rows.Line:
O-Oh, look at the time!
I have to get to a meeting!

rows.Speaker: Stagehand
rows.Line: Uhh... I need to help out over at my next set! Sorry, Haruka. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We hit a sudden dry spell after Idol Lovers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If someone else's actions are behind us not receiving offers during that period...)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I can't say I have heard anything.
I'm not sure I can help you.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: It seems like Mr. Hiiragi has been investing a lot of his time into ReLight after Idol Lovers.

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: They did start getting a ton of attention after that event. I'd also want to make the most of this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: I agree. In that sense, he really is a savvy producer.

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: He's always been passionate about what he does.

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line: Between how that event went and Mr. Hiiragi's marketing skills, every show wants ReLight right now.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: There's also that scary rumor about Mr. Hiiragi. I hope it's not true, but it's probably best not to rock the boat.

rows.Speaker: TV Station Staff Member's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, I have to start getting ready to go location scouting...

rows.Speaker: Nakano's Voice
rows.Line:
I also need to get to the studio...
I'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If Mr. Hiiragi is behind our offers just stopping all of the sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Above all else, I would never lose sight of my goals.
